title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

description:
Olá, nós somos a Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção .

Fazemos parte do Grupo Novonor e atuamos, principalmente, no Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos.

Temos mais de 80 anos de história, destes, 40 anos atuando em Angola, e nosso propósito é contribuir para a construção de um futuro sustentável, servindo à sociedade por meio da capacidade transformadora de nossa engenharia, acreditando e desenvolvendo profissionais locais para a realização do sonho dos nossos clientes.

Todos os dias, nos diversos países que atuamos, buscamos fornecer soluções para alguns dos maiores desafios do mundo - como educação, saúde, energia, água, transporte, habitação e saneamento.

Ao longo dos quase 40 anos de atuação em Angola, a Odebrecht cria e implementa programas que enriquecem as comunidades, apostando fortemente na criação de emprego, na formação de cidadãos angolanos e no desenvolvimento econômico e social do país.

Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma remota e nós encorajamos inscrições de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo.

A inscrição neste banco de talentos não garante a contratação, pois ela dependerá da avaliação de currículos e requisitos de cada uma das oportunidades.

Quem pode se candidatar?

title: Engenheiro / Técnico de Serviços de Campo - Microscopia | MG
description:
Sobre a ZEISS:

- Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

- Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.

Sobre a nossa Divisão de Microscopia:

- Como o maior fabricante de sistemas de microscópios, nós oferecemos soluções completas para pesquisa biomédica, para o setor de saúde e as indústrias de alta tecnologia. Cientistas famosos conquistaram o Prêmio Nobel e outras premiações por seus trabalhos com a ajuda de nossos produtos.

Base de Trabalho - Minas Gerais/MG

- Executar atividades de instalação e manutenção preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos comercializados pela empresa.

- Assegurar o adequado funcionamento dos equipamentos instalados nos clientes para evitar paradas operacionais, através da adequada interpretação dos dados e uso do conhecimento/ instruções técnicas, atuando conforme as diretrizes e métricas de qualidade, produtividade, atendimento, custos e segurança, saúde e meio ambiente.

Principais Responsabilidades:

- Seguir procedimentos e diretrizes preestabelecidas para instalação, manutenção, e conserto de produtos ou equipamentos adquiridos pelos clientes da empresa, contribuindo na melhoria dos mesmos.

- Instalar, prestar serviços de manutenção, ministrar treinamento a cliente e atualizar equipamentos em conformidade com instruções detalhadas e pedidos ordem de serviço.

- Fornecer manutenção programada nas instalações do cliente para assegurar o funcionamento contínuo e confiável dos equipamentos.

- Manter registros precisos dos serviços executados, a fim de cumprir com metas de desempenho individual e garantir que o desempenho do equipamento pode ser monitorado.

- Garantir a satisfação do cliente quanto às soluções de manutenção, de acordo com as métricas de atendimento, prazo, performance e qualidade definidas pela área.

- Desenvolver conhecimento dos produtos e serviços da empresa através de trabalho em conjunto com outros membros do time de Serviços (engenheiros e técnicos iniciantes) .

- Elaborar e enviar relatórios de serviços para cada atendimento realizado.

- Responder pela correta utilização, conservação, manutenção e otimização dos ativos da companhia, bem como garantir a limpeza e organização da área de trabalho.

Qualificações e Requisitos para essa posição:

- Graduação na área de Engenharia.

- Conhecimentos básicos em TI (formatar hardware, instalar softwares, configurar redes).

- Inglês Avançado.

- CNH em dia.

- Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais.

Experiência necessária:

- Experiência anterior com instalação e manutenção de equipamentos eletrotécnicos, e serviços de campo. Conhecimento ou experiência prévia com microscópios (eletrônicos, de luz, raio X e a laser) será um diferencial.

A ZEISS acredita na igualdade de oportunidades. Independentemente de gênero, idade, raça, cor, credo, orientação sexual e deficiência, todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas em nossos processos seletivos. Trabalhamos para construir um ambiente diverso e com equidade de

oportunidades. Valorizamos e respeitamos todas as diferenças.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players . Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and other international markets.

We are looking for data-driven innovators who want to shape the future of iGaming and make a real impact on the industry. We value integrity, a curious mindset, empathy, and a commitment to quality. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, and deployment of products that help companies engage with their customers in efficient and personal ways.

Our technology stack is built in Scala, NodeJS, and Ruby on Rails, running on Cassandra, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, and Kafka. We containerize and deploy with Kubernetes on AWS. You will be responsible for service delivery, reliability, scalability, monitoring, and helping define all this as immutable infrastructure-as-code.

Responsibilities:

  • Deploy and maintain critical applications on cloud-native microservices architecture.
  • Implement automation, effective monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Deploy and maintain CI/CD pipelines across multiple environments.
  • Support and work alongside a cross-functional engineering team on the latest technologies.
  • Iterate on best practices to increase the quality & velocity of deployments.
  • Sustain and improve the process of knowledge sharing throughout the engineering team.

Requirements:

  • Experience deploying and maintaining scalable, resilient and highly available systems in cloud environments.
  • Skills in automation of repetitive tasks (scripting via Bash, Python, Ruby).
  • Practical experience with Docker containerization and clustering (Kubernetes, ECS, Rancher).
  • Expertise with AWS (e.g., IAM, EC2, VPC, ELB, ALB, Autoscaling, Lambda).
  • Experience with version control system (e.g., Git, Gitlab).
  • Experience with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Working with us implies:

  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.

The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Scrum Master Sr
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.

O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).

Duties and Responsibilities:

· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;

· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;

· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;

· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;

· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;

· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;

· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;

· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;

· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;

· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);

· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe

· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade

· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil

· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios

· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade

· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum

Minimum Education:

· Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0

· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)

Other:

· English (plus)

title: Section Manager
description:
Section Manager - UAE

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a Section Manager, you’ll play a vital role in the successful execution of MEP works across complex data center projects. You’ll lead field productivity, manage change effectively, and ensure technical excellence in every phase.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

About Your Team

You’ll report directly to the Construction Manager, with indirect reporting to the Project Manager, and will lead a team of Site Engineers and Foremen. The section management team ensures quality, safety, productivity, and coordination across MEP disciplines, collaborating closely with planning, QA/QC, procurement, and subcontractors to ensure seamless execution across project zones and disciplines.

Your Role

As a Section Manager, you will:

  • Issue daily/weekly installation plans and report progress.
  • Enforce method statements, risk assessments, and DSTI schedules.
  • Track material deliveries in coordination with Project Engineers.
  • Manage change and drawing/spec distribution.
  • Monitor tools, consumables, KPIs, and labour productivity.
  • Ensure HSE and QA/QC compliance at all times.
  • Work week: Monday to Saturday (standard for project-based roles in the region)

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years’ experience in MEP construction or infrastructure
  • Strong knowledge of installation sequencing, QA/QC, and HSE
  • Site leadership and technical documentation experience
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills

What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

description:

  • Desenvolver e manter uma rede comercial consistente, contemplando carteira de clientes e rede de contatos que contribua para a geração de negócios da empresa.

DXC Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration. title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.

Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)

Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Noc Analyst
description:
É apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, orientado(a) a resultados e gosta de desafios?

Então venha fazer parte do time de UPXers e nos ajude em nossa missão: transformar a internet em um ambiente mais seguro para empresas e pessoas!

Com forte comprometimento, inovação e de forma dinâmica você será responsável por:

  • Auxiliar na configuração, manutenção e monitoramento de redes de computadores.
  • Prestar suporte técnico aos serviços oferecidos pela UPX ao cliente final.
  • Monitorar incidentes de redes, e ataques DDoS.
  • Auxiliar na configuração e gerenciamento de equipamentos de rede (roteadores, switches, firewalls, etc.).
  • Colaborar com a equipe de TI em projetos de infraestrutura e segurança.
  • Executar e documentar processos, procedimentos e incidentes relacionados à rede e à segurança de TI.
  • Participar de treinamentos e atualizações sobre novas tecnologias e práticas de segurança.

Desejável:

  • Cursando ou formado em Redes de Computadores, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de rede (IPv4, IPv6, TCP/UDP e DNS).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e segurança de redes.
  • Experiência prévia na instalação e configuração de equipamentos de rede, como roteadores, switches, firewalls e sistemas de detecção e prevenção de intrusão (IDS/IPS).
  • Habilidade para resolver problemas técnicos de forma ágil e eficiente.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.
  • Diferencial: Certificações como CCNA, JNCIA-Junos, JNCIA-DC, MTCNA ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com protocolo BGP é altamente desejável.

Buscamos por uma pessoa para o time da UPX que possua:

  • Disponibilidade de horário para atuar em escalas de revezamento, sem ser jornada Comercial.

Sobre a UPX:

A UPX está há duas décadas no mercado, é referência em mitigação de ataques DDoS, e destaque no monitoramento, identificação, tratamento, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo (CDN e Streaming) com elevado desempenho. Está presente em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), tem em seu portfólio grandes clientes do setor bancário e financeiro, operadoras de telecom e provedores de internet (ISP).

Atua combatendo ataques, vulnerabilidades e ameaças cibernéticas com apoio de um time técnico de Segurança da Informação e Engenharia de Redes que operam por meio de SOC (Security Operations Center), NOC (Network Operations Center) e Scrubbing Centers (Centros de Mitigação).

title: Representante Comercial | PJ/Parceria/Canal de Vendas | Divisão de Odontologia (atuação em Porto Alegre e Região)
description:
Vaga para Representante | PJ/ Parceria/ Canal de Vendas

Sobre a ZEISS:

Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.

Sobre a nossa Divisão Médica:

Oferecemos soluções completas para diagnósticos e tratamentos oftalmológicos, além da avançada tecnologia de radioterapia intraoperatória e soluções de visualização inovadoras para neurocirurgia, odontologia, entre outros. Nosso portfólio possui promissoras tecnologias do futuro que garante aos seus parceiros e clientes confiança e excelência.

Sobre a nossa vaga de Representante Comercial | PJ/Parceria/Canal de Vendas | Divisão de Odontologia (atuação em Porto Alegre e Região)

Estamos em busca de Representantes Comerciais apaixonados por inovação e excelência no atendimento ao cliente para se juntarem à nossa equipe na divisão de Odontologia.

Como representante da marca ZEISS, você será responsável por:

- Prospecção Ativa: Identificar e engajar novos clientes, expandindo nossa presença no mercado odontológico.

- Demonstração de Produtos: Apresentar as características e benefícios das nossas Lupas de Magnificação e Microscópios Cirúrgicos.

- Relacionamento com o Cliente: Realizar visitas de pós-venda para garantir a satisfação e fidelização, além de identificar novas oportunidades de negócio.

- Educação Continuada: Participar ativamente de cursos, congressos e eventos, mantendo-se atualizado sobre as tendências do setor.

- Gestão de Vendas: Utilizar o CRM para gerenciar o funil de vendas, apresentar previsões e fechar negócios de forma eficaz.

Requisitos:

- Experiência mínima de 8 anos em vendas no setor odontológico.

- Histórico comprovado de sucesso em vendas e superação de metas.

- Conhecimento profundo do mercado e produtos odontológicos.

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e relacionamento interpessoal.

- Disponibilidade para viagens e participação em eventos.

- Inglês em nível intermediário ou avançado será um diferencial.

Benefícios:

- Comissão competitiva por venda, oferecendo um potencial ilimitado de ganhos.

Se você está pronto para fazer parte de uma equipe que está na vanguarda da inovação em odontologia, aplique agora mesmo através do LinkedIn. A equipe da Carl Zeiss do Brasil está ansiosa para conhecer os próximos líderes de vendas que se juntarão a nós nessa jornada.

  • Graduação completa em administração de empresas, marketing, engenharia ou área relacionada;
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de construir e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo com clientes;
  • Excelentes habilidades de negociação e persuasão;
  • Orientação para resultados e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente em um ambiente dinâmico;
  • Forte capacidade analítica para identificar oportunidades e ótima comunicação para engajar cliente em projetos;
  • Disponibilidade para viajar conforme necessário.

title: MEP Project Engineer
description:
MEP Project Engineer - UAE

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We Are

ALEMCO, a trusted leader in integrated MEP and facilities services, is part of the ALEC Group. We are known for our innovative solutions, commitment to excellence, and ability to deliver complex projects on time and within budget.

With expertise spanning design, procurement, and execution, we are building a legacy of iconic projects that define the region. Discover how your skills can make an impact.

Why Join Us?

As a Project Engineer at ALEMCO, you’ll take ownership of engineering deliverables, ensuring that every aspect of your scope is compliant, cost-effective, and aligned with project timelines. This role offers a unique opportunity to work on groundbreaking projects while advancing your technical expertise.

About Your Team

You’ll report to the Technical Manager and oversee Technical Engineers in delivering high-quality MEP solutions. Your team operates in a collaborative environment, integrating design, procurement, and site operations for seamless project execution.

Your Role

  • Ensure compliance with project specs, codes, and regulations.
  • Oversee material submittals, procurement, and long-lead item management.
  • Coordinate designs with drafting teams and offshore resources.
  • Lead on-site supervision, ensuring quality, safety, and progress.
  • Collaborate with subcontractors and support testing/commissioning phases.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 10+ years in MEP engineering/project execution
  • Knowledge: Local & international codes, BIM 360, Revit
  • Skills: QA/QC, design validation, procurement, MS Office
  • Qualifications: BSc in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronic Engineering

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to contribute to iconic infrastructure projects in the UAE.
  • A supportive environment that values innovation, teamwork, and technical excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
  • Tax-free earnings & relocation package

Ready to Engineer the Future?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and play a key role in delivering high-performance MEP solutions for transformative projects.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

  • Conhecimento técnico com relação à apuração de PIS/COFINS sobe produtos monofásicos.

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 60+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.

Roles we commonly hire for in Brazil

  • Business Analyst
  • Data Analyst
  • Data Scientist
  • Designer
  • Finance Analyst
  • FinCrime Analyst
  • Operations Manager
  • Product Manager
  • Recruiter
  • Software Engineer
  • Support Specialist

This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.

If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.

Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.

Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our .

Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.

What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.

What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently, clearly, and accurately to all levels
  • A confident, self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail

Nice to have

  • Fluency in another language
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: BIM Modeler - Civil
description:
Civil BIM Modeler - Design | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil BIM Modeler , you will be responsible for developing and managing BIM models for our construction projects in compliance with ISO19650 and company standards. You will lead the BIM modeling efforts, coordinate with project teams, ensure model accuracy, and support BIM QA/QC processes to deliver quality outputs that meet project requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review Tender & IFC BIM models, 2D drawings, and asset data issued by consultants in line with ISO19650 standards.
  • Lead BIM modeling for design documents; guide and mentor a team of modelers.
  • Prepare BIM models and generate general arrangement plans, diagrams, sections, elevations, and schedules using Revit.
  • Maintain and optimize BIM models following best industry practices to ensure healthy, coordinated models.
  • Coordinate with BIM and design teams to support modeling from 2D CAD plans and construction documents.
  • Conduct clash detection and support clash avoidance measures.
  • Assist internal and external stakeholders with the development and updating of construction documents.
  • Maintain and apply company/project BIM standards, templates, and content.
  • Update models and drawings based on RFI responses, engineering instructions, and design changes.
  • Identify discrepancies in contract documents and report them promptly.
  • Ensure all work complies with project information standards, BIM Execution Plans, and ALEC BIM implementation standards.
  • Support as-built/redline and handover processes by updating models and extracting accurate drawings.
  • Provide timely and accurate information to site teams and project managers.
  • Follow a Monday to Saturday work schedule consistent with project-based industry norms.

What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma in Architecture or Civil Engineering (3 years).
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as a BIM Modeler in GCC countries.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD .
  • Advanced knowledge of BIM fundamentals, principles, and workflows.
  • Experience working in a collaborative shared environment.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency with Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Advanced skills in MS Office and Adobe Acrobat.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

Kindly upload your CV in English.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil BIM Modeler , you will be responsible for developing and managing BIM models for our construction projects in compliance with ISO19650 and company standards. You will lead the BIM modeling efforts, coordinate with project teams, ensure model accuracy, and support BIM QA/QC processes to deliver quality outputs that meet project requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review Tender & IFC BIM models, 2D drawings, and asset data issued by consultants in line with ISO19650 standards.
  • Lead BIM modeling for design documents; guide and mentor a team of modelers.
  • Prepare BIM models and generate general arrangement plans, diagrams, sections, elevations, and schedules using Revit.
  • Maintain and optimize BIM models following best industry practices to ensure healthy, coordinated models.
  • Coordinate with BIM and design teams to support modeling from 2D CAD plans and construction documents.
  • Conduct clash detection and support clash avoidance measures.
  • Assist internal and external stakeholders with the development and updating of construction documents.
  • Maintain and apply company/project BIM standards, templates, and content.
  • Update models and drawings based on RFI responses, engineering instructions, and design changes.
  • Identify discrepancies in contract documents and report them promptly.
  • Ensure all work complies with project information standards, BIM Execution Plans, and ALEC BIM implementation standards.
  • Support as-built/redline and handover processes by updating models and extracting accurate drawings.
  • Provide timely and accurate information to site teams and project managers.
  • Follow a Monday to Saturday work schedule consistent with project-based industry norms.

What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma in Architecture or Civil Engineering (3 years).
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as a BIM Modeler in GCC countries.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD .
  • Advanced knowledge of BIM fundamentals, principles, and workflows.
  • Experience working in a collaborative shared environment.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency with Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Advanced skills in MS Office and Adobe Acrobat.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

title: IT Risk & Audit Professional
description:
Are you our new colleague?

We’re looking for a IT risk & audit professional at Randstad Global

Sao Paolo, Brazil, hybrid, fulltime

BR&AF

The business risk and audit function (BR&AF) provides assurance and recommendations to the Executive Board and the Audit Committee on Randstad Group’s (risk) management, control and governance practices. Therefore the department facilitates in setting governance standards. It provides advice on internal control improvements, it conducts audits, special investigations and assignments worldwide on request of the Executive Board and Audit Committee. BR&AF’s responsibility includes the quarterly reporting based on: the risk and internal control self assessments, audit results, discussions on internal control weaknesses and analysis of the key risks reported throughout the company's management structure. This also substantiates the Group’s in-control statements.

The global function consists of team members operating through hubs spread over 4 continents. The team is organized in a matrix consisting of control & audit focus teams on business and functional areas (e.g. digital, talent, client, back office & shared service centers and fraud & forensics) and partners that are the linking pin to operating units (business risk & audit partners) with a global view. A support group is set up for professional practice, learning & development, quality improvement & methods, analytics and PMO.

Representatives of the different groups (Focus teams, BR&A Partners and support group) form the BR&AF core management team that reports to the Managing Director BR&AF.

how you will contribute

As IT auditor you are part of the, Business Risk & Audit - IT focus team and are going to:

  • perform and assist internal audit projects and internal control evaluation related to 'digital' processes, such as general IT processes, IT program & project management, 3rd party assurance, security, business IT (automated) controls, RPA, AI and BCP.
  • together with other team members you coordinate, execute and report on the outcomes of risk management, internal control and internal audit in close collaboration with other involved and impacted functions within the group, such as IT and global IT program organizations
  • provide coaching & development for your team members with respect to IT general controls, application controls and other technical expertise's required within Risk & Audit.
  • support the planning, execution and reporting of the risk, internal control and internal audit activities in your domain to make impact. You know your impact is there when management follows-up on your reports by implementing operational and control improvements.

what you will be doing

  • participate in risk assessments and assist in audit planning and scoping, such as: IT general controls, automated controls, RPA and IT projects.
  • perform IT controls/process audits on scope elements.
  • lead and execute audits, for technical domains, including: physical security, ethical hacking and technical validation of controls on multiple OSI layers.
  • support combined comfort analyses on maturity of IT general controls relevant domains (combining audit insights with other sources of data such as internal control projects, management controls self-assessment and developments within the company)
  • participate and lead audit interviews, accountable to prepare audit workpapers and reporting, as well as assist in drafting audit findings and recommendations for management based on identified control weaknesses or process improvements.
  • support and monitor the follow-up implementation of corrective actions by management.
  • act as a resource for colleagues with less expertise.

who will you work with

  • Partners/communities within the IT operations and projects space
  • IT security, data protection, information security and business continuity communities within the Randstad organization.
  • Business risk & audit partners
  • IT & digital leadership
  • External co-source partners
  • BR &A F stakeholders/clients within the business including local MT's, process and control owners

what you will bring

Your in depth understanding and experience with general IT management processes, business enabling through it (automated controls, RPA and IA) combined with risk & audit skills are well developed. As a critical challenger to management you strike the right tone. You have a keen interest in enabling an effective balance in managing IT effectively while enabling the business to operate optimally leveraging IT. You have a sharp eye for improvements strengthening management controls structurally in the context of what works best within the company setting and not taking it from a theoretical perspective.

You:

  • have minimum 5 to 8 years of relevant experience
  • have at minimum a bachelor degree in IT, business or economics.
  • are qualified as IT auditor (e.g. CISA, RE or equivalent).

You work and act in a way that:

  • creates clarity - showing line of sight (analytical skills): you collect and analyze data to solve problems, make decisions and advice within your professional boundaries.
  • collaborates, reaches out (organizational sensitivity): maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process and people-related organizational dynamics recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization
  • ensures the business, thus: align, improve, execute and promote systems and work processes that support the business in achieving its goals and complies with internal and external standards and regulatory requirements.
  • co-drives the business, thus: provide insights into drivers for value creation and act as business partner in making decisions that enhance performance.
  • applies outside- in thinking (curiosity), with: unrest to push the boundary, eagerness, examination of new possibilities by investigating and asking questions, exploring and/or discovering new possibilities and assuming something better is still out there. You are comfortable leading what isn’t understood.

As IT auditor you:

  • have a strong independent mindset
  • are experienced in international stakeholder management & change
  • are an innovative thinker that challenges the status quo

have an agile and flexible working style and passion for on the job coaching and development

Your competences demonstrates you can:

  • support the development of an audit universe and audit approaches on IT risks and opportunities, as well as assist in building cyber assurance practices within Randstad.
  • prepare audit plannings and scoping on identified (cyber) risks & opportunities.
  • lead and execute internal audits/review for operational business processes, with focus on cyber and give guidance and/or instructions to junior staff in audit projects.
  • report and communicate audit findings at the right tone to make impact and provide recommendations for improvements.

Your Business English is at level BEC B1/B2 or higher.

As the standard office locations for the BR&AF team are organized in hubs, like in the country mentioned, it is relevant, as part of the job, you are willing to travel. Travelling is estimated to be about 20% to 30% of the job.

your competencies

Within Randstad we defined the following Leadership competencies:

  • delighting people: connect people (client, talent, employee, society), building strong client relationships and delivering client-centric solutions.
  • performing today: resourcefulness securing and developing resources effectively and efficiently.
  • leading change: manages ambiguity operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
  • securing the future: drives vision and purpose painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others into action.
  • strategic mindset: seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies
  • creating clarity - showing line of sight: making sense of complex, high quantity and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems and provides direction, is delegating and removing obstacles to get work done
  • courage to challenge: shows courage and confidence to speak up skillfully, challenging others even when they are confronted with resistance or unfamiliar circumstances

what’s in it for you

We put people at the heart of everything we do. Our employment conditions reflect this and are in accordance with the applicable (local) Randstad employment policies and related personnel guide.

We want our teams and talent to reflect the rich diversity of the societies we serve. We thrive for an environment of belonging, safety and confidence. So everyone can bring their whole selves to work and flourish. Learn more about equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging at randstad .

title: Representante Comercial | PJ/Parceria/Canal de Vendas | Divisão de Odontologia (atuação em Rio de Janeiro e Região)
description:
Vaga para Representante | PJ/ Parceria/ Canal de Vendas

Sobre a ZEISS:

Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.

Sobre a nossa Divisão Médica:

Oferecemos soluções completas para diagnósticos e tratamentos oftalmológicos, além da avançada tecnologia de radioterapia intraoperatória e soluções de visualização inovadoras para neurocirurgia, odontologia, entre outros. Nosso portfólio possui promissoras tecnologias do futuro que garante aos seus parceiros e clientes confiança e excelência.

Sobre a nossa vaga de Representante Comercial | PJ/Parceria/Canal de Vendas | Divisão de Odontologia (atuação em Rio de Janeiro e Região)

Estamos em busca de Representantes Comerciais apaixonados por inovação e excelência no atendimento ao cliente para se juntarem à nossa equipe na divisão de Odontologia.

Como representante da marca ZEISS, você será responsável por:

- Prospecção Ativa: Identificar e engajar novos clientes, expandindo nossa presença no mercado odontológico.

- Demonstração de Produtos: Apresentar as características e benefícios das nossas Lupas de Magnificação e Microscópios Cirúrgicos.

- Relacionamento com o Cliente: Realizar visitas de pós-venda para garantir a satisfação e fidelização, além de identificar novas oportunidades de negócio.

- Educação Continuada: Participar ativamente de cursos, congressos e eventos, mantendo-se atualizado sobre as tendências do setor.

- Gestão de Vendas: Utilizar o CRM para gerenciar o funil de vendas, apresentar previsões e fechar negócios de forma eficaz.

Requisitos:

- Experiência mínima de 8 anos em vendas no setor odontológico.

- Histórico comprovado de sucesso em vendas e superação de metas.

- Conhecimento profundo do mercado e produtos odontológicos.

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e relacionamento interpessoal.

- Disponibilidade para viagens e participação em eventos.

- Desejável conhecimento em CRM SAP.

- Inglês em nível intermediário ou avançado será um diferencial.

Benefícios:

- Comissão competitiva por venda, oferecendo um potencial ilimitado de ganhos.

ATUAÇÃO COMO PARCEIRO/ REPRESENTANTE/ CANAL DE VENDAS (PJ)

Se você está pronto para fazer parte de uma equipe que está na vanguarda da inovação em odontologia, aplique agora mesmo através do LinkedIn. A equipe da Carl Zeiss do Brasil está ansiosa para conhecer os próximos líderes de vendas que se juntarão a nós nessa jornada.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida na gestão de grandes contas B2B e relacionamento executivo;

Diferenciais:

  • Vivência internacional ou interação com stakeholders globais;
  • Capacidade analítica e perfil colaborativo;
  • Visão de negócios e senso de urgência.

title: BMS Commissioning Engineer
description:
BMS Commissioning Engineer - UAE

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a Commissioning Engineer, you’ll lead the commissioning of Building Management Systems (BMS) across key project sections. From planning resources to optimizing system performance, you’ll play a crucial role in ensuring high-quality installations and efficient site execution.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

Your Role

  • Conduct all BMS commissioning phases: Pre-functional, Functional, and Integrated Systems Testing
  • Perform software/hardware integration with third-party systems
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system defects, supporting other trades and contractors
  • Develop, test, and commission BMS control programs based on detailed Sequences of Operation
  • Oversee Site Acceptance Tests and demonstrate systems to consultants and clients
  • Fine-tune system parameters to meet design intent and maximize energy efficiency
  • Manage installation teams and day-to-day site activities, including labor, materials, and equipment
  • Coordinate with the commissioning manager and document all commissioning activities
  • Ensure all technical documentation, QA/QC protocols, and HSE compliance are maintained
  • Control drawing management and track updates for as-built submissions
  • Record team efficiencies and report delays, constraints, or deviations
  • Oversee handover documentation, including spares, warranty details, and compliance statements

What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma in Electrical Engineering (required)
  • Minimum 10 years of hands-on commissioning experience, especially in BMS and integrated systems
  • Strong leadership, decision-making, and communication abilities
  • Proven success handling teams, budgets, and project timelines
  • Ability to work under pressure with autonomy and precision
  • Familiar with project specifications, construction drawings, and commercial coordination

What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Keeta-Sales Efficiency Operation Manager (SAKA)
description:
About US：

Keeta is an independent brand of Meituan, the world's largest tech-driven retail company. We focus on food and consumer product delivery services in international markets with the mission: "We help people eat better, live better".

Established in March 2010, Meituan has helped transform the supply and demand of service and product retail across the digital landscape.

As Meituan and Keeta continue to increase R&D investment and advance in new technologies, we uphold a customer-centric approach, working with our partners to provide quality services to customers.

What You'll Do:

  1. Sales Process Optimization: Familiarize with the entire "find-interview-sign-onboard-operate" process and operational pain points of the franchise brand team BD, and establish standardized operational processes to enhance team efficiency.
  2. Sales Tool Development: Identify key points that constrain the improvement of sales productivity, and drive the product and research teams to build and implement sales tools.
  3. Merchant Tool Development: Identify merchant needs and pain points, and promote optimization of merchant-side product capabilities to enhance online operational efficiency for merchants.
  4. Project Management: Use project management methods to ensure effective execution of key business processes and product capabilities. Fully mobilize resources from strategy, product, and operation team to drive the franchise brand team in achieving business objectives.

What We Need From You:

1. Experience: more than 2 years of experience in merchant operations, promotion preparations, and sales team operations.

2. Data analysis skills: proficient with various analysis software, capable of conducting multi-dimensional analysis and making informed business judgments.

3. Market insight: information sensitivity to the market and industry, able to capture development trends and formulate strategies.

4. Project management ability: good at communication and expression, strong coordination, team consciousness, and organization ability.

The following are preferred :

1. Experience in the food delivery industry and local-based service industry is preferred.

2. Proficient in using SQL or other data analysis tools.

3. Experience in merchant operations/strategy operations/product operations preferred.

4. English/Portuguese can be used as a working language.

What Make This Role Exciting:

1. Startup team, full of opportunities to participate in core projects for rapid growth.

2. Being able to experience different countries, languages, and cultures.

title: MEP Technical Engineer
description:
MEP Technical Engineer - UAE

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As an MEP Technical Engineer, you'll work alongside project leaders to ensure technical documents meet precise specifications, coordinate on-site execution, and uphold the quality of all MEP works. From pre-construction planning to close-out documentation, you'll help keep projects running smoothly and compliantly.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

Your Role

  • Support Project Engineers in planning MEP systems for efficient project delivery
  • Prepare and review technical submittals, including drawings, materials, calculations, method statements, and reports
  • Maintain accuracy and completeness of technical documentation
  • Monitor and track submittal approvals to uphold timelines and quality expectations
  • Coordinate with other disciplines to ensure integrated site execution
  • Provide timely resolutions to site technical issues
  • Conduct site inspections to monitor work progress and compliance
  • Ensure installations meet local and international codes, standards, and project specifications
  • Assist with quantity take-offs, procurement, and logistics of MEP materials
  • Contribute to as-built documentation and final handover packages
  • Participate in meetings and maintain clear communication with all stakeholders
  • Pursue continuous learning through courses, seminars, and certifications

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (required)
  • 5 years of technical experience in MEP construction
  • Solid knowledge of MEP systems and design processes
  • Proficiency in MS Office; experience with Revit preferred
  • Familiarity with Autodesk tools and collaborative platforms
  • Strong understanding of design techniques and emerging technologies
  • Knowledge of relevant international and regional codes and standards
  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills

What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

description:
Sucesso profissional é o resultado de trabalhar com o que você gosta e que faz a diferença no mundo e na vida das pessoas! Se você é uma pessoa aberta, positiva, conectada, tem entusiasmo, curte inovação é responsável e acredita que o futuro da mobilidade pode ser trilhado com soluções que tragam melhores experiências aos clientes, o seu lugar é aqui. Renault, uma marca humana, calorosa, inovadora e responsável! Venha fazer parte do nosso time Renault Group!

Missão da área:

Desenvolver soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para carrocerias e peças automotivas, garantindo excelência em design, funcionalidade e segurança, com o objetivo de proporcionar uma experiência superior aos clientes e contribuir para um futuro mais verde e tecnológico.

Sustentabilidade: Adotar práticas e materiais sustentáveis que reduzam o impacto ambiental e promovam a eficiência energética.

Segurança: Garantir que todos os produtos atendam aos mais altos padrões de segurança, protegendo os ocupantes e melhorando a durabilidade dos veículos.

Qualidade: Manter um rigoroso controle de qualidade em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento, desde a concepção até a produção.

Experiência do Cliente: Focar na satisfação do cliente, oferecendo produtos que atendam às suas necessidades e superem suas expectativas.

Coordenador:

Se você tem experiência em Gestão de Projetos e Conhecimento de Engenharia Automotiva, é movido por tarefas dinâmicas e gosta de trabalhar em equipes multidisciplinares, essa é uma grande oportunidade para mostrar seu potencial.

Uma das características desse desafio é a capacidade de Liderar Equipes Transversais e conectar Pessoas, Processos e Conhecimentos para atingir os resultados necessários e assegurar a Satisfação Total do Cliente.   • Atuar desde a concepção de um novo projeto, passando pelo desenvolvimento, vendas e pós-vendas, e continuamos gerando valor e satisfação para os clientes durante todo o ciclo de vida do projeto.
  • Ser responsável pelas atividades necessárias para assegurar a convergência dos objetivos de Qualidade no lançamento de Novos Projetos de Veículos e Powertrain, tais como: Rodagem de Confirmação de Qualidade, Pré-Operação de Lançamento, Frota de Satisfação Cliente, Operação de Lançamentos etc.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia e áreas afins;
  • Pós-graduação/MBA em Gestão de Projetos será diferencial.
  • Capacidade de comunicar-se em francês ou Inglês (Fluente profissionalmente);
  • Ter experiência e Conhecimento de Engenharia Automotiva e de Ferramentas de Qualidade;
  • Talentos de Liderança, Planejamento, Analítico, Comunicação e Visão de Satisfação do Cliente são bem-vindos.
  • Conhecimento em Peças de automóveis e Processos automotivos (e.g. Estamparia, carroceria, montagem, pintura ...)
  • Conhecimento profundo sobre peças automotivas e processos de fabricação relacionados a Carroceria e peças de design exterior (sistema e mecanismos)
  • Habilidade para gerenciar cronogramas, orçamentos e recursos de forma eficiente.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos como PMBOK, Agile, e softwares como MS Project.
  • Competência em análise de dados e relatórios financeiros para tomar decisões informadas a nível econômico do veículo;

title: Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência - Araucária/PR
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Warehouse Procurement Manager
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle e-retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Requirements

  • Sourcing & Vendor Management: Identify, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers and vendors to secure the best prices, quality, and delivery terms. Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers, ensuring reliability and alignment with our brand values.
  • Purchasing Strategy: Develop and implement procurement strategies that drive cost savings, quality improvements, and operational efficiency. Analyze market trends and supplier performance to make informed procurement decisions.
  • Inventory management: Collaborate with inventory management teams to ensure optimal stock levels and timely replenishment of products. Monitor inventory turnover rates and implement strategies to minimize excess stock and reduce carrying costs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with production, quality, engineering, and quality teams to ensure that procurement aligns with product development and promotional strategies. Participate in product development meetings to provide insights on material sourcing and cost implications.
  • Sustainability Initiatives: Champion sustainable sourcing practices and collaborate with suppliers to promote environmentally friendly materials and processes. Monitor compliance with ethical sourcing standards and regulations.
  • Budget Management: Prepare and manage the procurement budget, ensuring alignment with financial goals and targets. Track and report on savings and procurement performance metrics.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Fashion Merchandising, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in procurement within the fashion retail industry.

Preferred Skills

  • Being familiar with normal logistic packing material and service related to warehouse running.
  • Strong negotiation skills and experience with contract management.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful procurement strategies.
  • Knowledge of sustainable and ethical sourcing practices.
  • Proficiency in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Fluent English.

CAREERS AT SHEIN

We Commit to Inclusion

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.

We Engage with Global Cultures

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

Durante os anos 1990, a consultoria iniciou um programa de expansão internacional, formando alianças estratégicas com organizações imobiliárias em todo o mundo, período em que se estabeleceu também no Brasil, maior mercado imobiliário da América Latina.

Em 2023 realizamos o que foi um marco significativo para o setor imobiliário, anunciamos a fusão entre a Binswanger Brazil e a SDS Properties. Nossa decisão, motivada pela oportunidade de combinarmos tecnologia, dados, relacionamentos e expertise de equipes altamente referenciadas, buscou potencializar ferramentas, inteligência de mercado, capacidade de inovação e consequentemente apresentar aos nossos clientes o mais alto nível de atendimento em Real Estate do país.

  • Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's Degree

Computer Science, Engineering or related field

EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 4 years’ experience developing, validating, and implementing data warehouses, data systems or cloud-based data solutions.

COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

Estamos em busca de uma Social Media proativa, executora e criativa, com olhar apurado para captação de conteúdo e atenção aos detalhes, para atuar no dia a dia da nossa loja.

✅ O que você vai fazer:

• Gravar vídeos do dia a dia com o celular (stories, bastidores, conteúdos leves e espontâneos)

• Garantir que o cenário esteja sempre impecável (sem sujeiras, distrações ou aparelhos mal posicionados)

• Trabalhar em dupla com outra Social Media que já grava bem, ajudando a orientar e incentivar as gravações

• Criar ideias de conteúdos para stories e Reels de forma constante

• Ajudar na criação de campanhas (como Black Friday, Natal, etc.)

• Cumprir metas de conteúdo semanal, como gravações e postagens no feed

• Manter o planejamento e organização das demandas (seguindo prazos e cronograma)

⚠️ O que a gente NÃO quer:

• Alguém que só execute quando for cobrada

• Falta de atenção nos detalhes visuais (aparelho mal limpo, cenário desorganizado, iluminação ruim)

• Postagens e gravações feitas de qualquer jeito ou na correria

• Falta de iniciativa e comprometimento com entregas e metas

Perfil ideal:

• Proatividade: não espera ordens para agir. Viu uma oportunidade de gravação? Vai lá e faz.

• Visão estética: sabe o que é um cenário bonito, limpo, iluminado, com bom ângulo.

• Criatividade: traz ideias diferentes para conteúdos do dia a dia e campanhas pontuais.

• Organização: cumpre prazos, ajuda a planejar o conteúdo com antecedência.

• Boa convivência: vai trabalhar em parceria com outra Social Media, então precisa somar.

• Mão na massa: queremos quem coloca a mão na câmera, na edição e na entrega.

Importante:

Você não vai fazer vídeos de campanha com câmera profissional – isso já temos com um filmmaker. Mas precisa saber gravar com o celular, editar vídeos simples e entregar conteúdo com constância e qualidade.
